coaching.headline: We won three fights to their ten; a mid-game collapse from 14 to 23 cost five towers and the game.
coaching.team: Two lanes read favored -- carry against Skylar and offlane against Legion, both 'ours all game' -- against two unfavored ones, midlane against Gideon and jungle against Aurora, with no dedicated healer against their Mourn. Gideon took first blood on Argus at 2.4. Early Fangtooths at 8 and 13 were real trades against lost skirmishes, not clean losses. The turn was the 18.7-minute fight: a full-squad 3-6 loss, the match's most significant, handed over the Outer Tower at 20. The same shape repeated -- caught 4 versus 5 at 21 minutes with Argus already dead, and again at 35.1 with Boris caught alone 49 seconds earlier -- both times with Zarus alive and ahead in his own lane but not credited in the fight. We even won the 31-minute fight 4-2 and still lost the Inner Tower and both Inhibitors in that window, trading the fight for their Orb Prime. Towers finished 5 to 10, river control 7 to 25.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 18.7-minute fight, lost 3-6, is the match's single highest-significance moment; it gave up the Outer Tower at 20, and two more towers fell before the stretch eased off.
coaching.whatWorked: We converted two of our three won fights into a prize within ninety seconds, the one clean positive in a night we won just three fights total.

perPlayer.fa9e9ccf-fd66-43b3-899c-9cb92caab106: GRIM.exe won the carry matchup all game against Skylar, but that edge converted into just 2 kills on 9 deaths and 22,713 hero damage, second-lowest on the team. Only one of those deaths, at 8.8, was a solo catch by Mourn -- the rest fell inside team fights.
perPlayer.a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Argus lost the midlane matchup to Gideon, the enemy's clear best player (10 kills, 3 deaths, 32,998 damage), yet still topped our own kill count at 9 while completing the full winning midlane core. This is Cuban Noobster's third distinct lane across four films -- offlane, jungle, offlane, now midlane.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Gadget led the team in hero damage at 32,226 and held 50% kill participation, but finished 0 of 3 support core items (missing Azure Core, Entropy, Overseer) and was outwarded by Mourn 11 wards to 35. Three of eight deaths were solo catches, two of them late in the match, echoing a pattern from three films back on Lt. Belica (3 caught alone).
perPlayer.20535187-372c-474a-a155-410e3755ca27: Boris lost the jungle matchup to Aurora all game and finished only Sky Splitter from the winning jungle core, missing Basilisk and Rapture for four off-meta picks.
perPlayer.f40565ae-3694-4538-84ad-0477e83453de: Zarus won the offlane matchup against Legion all game, but logged the team's lowest hero damage at 14,681 on 2 kills and 6 deaths.

focus.evidence: GRIM.exe and Zarus both read 'ours all game' in lane, yet both were flagged alive and ahead but not credited in multiple skirmishes. GRIM.exe was flagged for the fights at 7.5 and 11.7, then again at 14.3 and 16.5. Zarus was flagged for the 21-minute and 35.1-minute fights we lost 4-versus-5.
focus.action: Next game, when a lane edge reads favored, shove and rotate into the next skirmish instead of continuing to farm -- especially once the team is already down a body.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Mourn Abduct (pull). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Mourn. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Energy Shield block → Displacement Blast → Assault Mode → GTFO lockon ult
ourKits.winCondition: out-trade with Pulsefire and the spell-shield, finish with GTFO
ourKits.playWith: peel so he can free-cast in Assault Mode
ourKits.playAgainst: bait Energy Shield, then commit; dodge GTFO's slow channel

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

ourKits.combo: Detection Protocol track → Chrono Swipe → Primeval Roar shield → Ursine Burst grab ult
ourKits.winCondition: grab a key target out of position and burst them down
ourKits.playWith: a team that collapses on his grabbed target
ourKits.playAgainst: his grab ult is the whole threat — bait it / stay spaced; CC during Primeval Roar

ourKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
ourKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
ourKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
ourKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Abduct pull → Contagion ally-heal bugs → Beguile damage-reduction → Eclipse vision-denial ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and sustain the team through the brawl
enemyKits.playWith: burst that punishes his pulled target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect the long Abduct channel/range; anti-heal blunts Contagion

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down
